slides.texte_overlay:
Daily habits that quietly
make you brilliant
Ask one big question every day. Why is the sky blue? How do planes stay up? Looking for the answer trains your curiosity like a muscle.
Read the news from two different sources. Seeing how the same story is told differently teaches you to think for yourself.
Do a puzzle with your morning coffee. Sudoku, a crossword, a chess problem. Five minutes of mental effort wakes your mind up.
Listen more than you speak. Every person knows something you don't. Brilliant people collect ideas from everyone around them.
Feed your mind daily. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and small lessons every morning keep me sharp all day.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Small lessons every morning keep me sharp all day.

slides.texte_overlay: Write a short summary of what you read. Three lines in your own words. It turns information into real understanding. Short summaries, deep memory.
Go to bed at the same time. Regular sleep is when your brain stores everything you learned. Brilliance needs rest. Seven to eight hours, every night, no exceptions.
